stories.title: Professional theme and color scheme
stories.acceptance_criteria: app.py: page_icon is professional (not casual emoji). Global CSS adds a corporate color palette (blues/grays). Typography and message styling feel professional. Mobile responsiveness preserved.

stories.title: Clean headers and labels
stories.acceptance_criteria: All pages (employee_interface, personal_timesheet, export_interface, manager_dashboard, login): headers and button labels use professional text, not emoji-heavy labels. E.g. 'Employee Clock In/Out' not '👤 Employee Clock In/Out', 'Clock In' not '🟢 Clock In'. Functionality unchanged.

stories.title: Layout and trust signals
stories.acceptance_criteria: Subtle card-style containers or dividers where appropriate. Improved spacing and visual hierarchy. Tables and forms have clean borders and readable layout. Overall appearance feels corporate and trustworthy.
